links.comparator_used: Long-context prompting with the most recent clinical notes (and smaller amounts of recent-note context)
links.outcome: Extraction and reasoning performance over inpatient EHR notes (F1 for imaging procedures, Jaccard for antibiotic timelines, diagnosis generation) and token use
links.effect: Imaging Procedures: RAG exceeded long-context performance by 0.17-9.83 F1 across all models using <8K tokens. Antibiotic Timelines: <8K retrieved tokens matched long-context recent-notes performance (-3.26 to +3.24 Jaccard). Diagnosis Generation: performance largely static across methods and models.
links.quote: For Imaging Procedures, RAG strongly outperformed recent-note inputs and exceeded long-context performance (by 0.17-9.83 F1 across all models) using fewer than 8K tokens.
